settings.question: How can I track the shipping status of my order?
settings.answer: Once your artisanal order is hand-packaged and dispatched, you will receive an SMS and email notification with an automated live tracking link. You can also WhatsApp our concierge at +91 91372 54894 with your Order # for instant dispatch updates.

settings.question: What is the standard delivery timeline across India and internationally?
settings.answer: Domestic orders are delivered within 2–4 business days across Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, and major metro cities, and 4–6 business days for the rest of India. Express dispatch is available upon request via our WhatsApp concierge.

settings.question: Are all Myra Veda formulations 100% vegetarian, cruelty-free, and clean?
settings.answer: Yes, absolutely. Myra Veda is proud to be India's first sustainable clean-beauty brand certified 100% vegetarian and cruelty-free. We formulate without parabens, sulphates, silicones, synthetic colorants, and 400+ prohibited toxic chemicals.

settings.question: How do I request bespoke gift hampers for weddings or corporate events?
settings.answer: We curate bespoke #MYRAkhi luxury gift hampers and corporate wellness gift suites. Select 'Bespoke Gifting & Festive Hampers' in the contact form or email gifting@myravedaluxury.com with your quantities and desired customization.

settings.question: Can I receive a personalized skin or hair ritual consultation?
settings.answer: Yes! Our in-house Ayurvedic ritual advisors offer complimentary consultations to curate the ideal botanical regimen based on your dosha and specific skin or hair goals. Simply message us on WhatsApp to begin.
